description:
Lists all subdomains for a domain

HTTP: GET /v1/domains/:id/subdomains
Category: Domains
Required scopes: domains:read
Returns: {status, data: array of {id, domain_id, subdomain_name, full_name, document_root, php_version, php_handler, ssl_enabled, ssl_provider, ssl_mode, ssl_cert_path, ssl_key_path, … (+11 more)}, total}
Read-only.

_fields.description: Comma-separated item fields to keep, e.g. "id,domain_name,php_version" — trims large items to what you need.

_limit.description: Keep only the first N items of the returned list (applied by this MCP server, not the panel). Use on large lists.

_match.description: Keep only items whose JSON contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. a domain name or status.

id.description: UUID of the domain — obtain it from GET /v1/domains

name: panelica_domains_get_v1_domains_id_subdomains
